fit.note: Joint fit of all exposures: position + free proper motion + catalogue parallax + one detector-fixed centroid bias per detector (saturated core, wing-only fit). The March season calibrates the bias, so only the same-orientation pair is an independent check.

measured.method: pixel-integrated 2D Gaussian fit to the unsaturated wings in native 6.15" pixels (saturated core excluded), converted with each exposure's SIP WCS; per-detector centroid bias removed by the joint fit (see 'fit'); season position = mean of the exposures after clipping. Gaia prediction = proper motion + annual parallax (Earth barycentric).

measured.message: Detected above 5σ in every season and wavelength bin.

detection.message: Detected above 5σ in every season and wavelength bin.
detection.method: forced fit of the SPHEREx empirical PSF (EPSF extension) at the predicted position, flux free, catalogue neighbours and Gaia DR3 field stars fitted at fixed positions, constant background; 11x11 native-pixel stamp; inverse-variance mean per season; errors scaled by the robust S/N scatter of the same fit at random positions (noise_scale).
detection.flux_unit_note: uJy within the EPSF footprint (+-3.3 px); far wings not included
detection.blend_note: Gaia DR3 field stars are fitted together with the target; sources not in Gaia (e.g. very red objects) are not modelled.

measured.finding: SPHEREx's infrared position is offset from the Gaia DR3 prediction by about +0.27″ E, −0.53″ N, the same in both spacecraft orientations, and larger at 4–5 µm than at 1–3 µm. This is consistent with the unresolved Ba+Bb binary (Gaia DR3 RUWE 4.30): the infrared photocentre differs from Gaia's G-band photocentre, plus orbital motion since 2016.

data_source: NASA/IPAC IRSA SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 spectral images
